text:
Sam (Sales): Heads up — customer wants to finalize PO + order form today. They need exec signature + procurement + finance signers. DPA has a couple redlines (encryption, subprocessor list). Can we confirm routing and SLA for the POC?
Alex (Legal): I looked at the attached DPA redlines. Main asks: explicit AES-256 at rest, vendor subproc list disclosure, and narrower data processing purpose. SLA redline: they want 99.95% for inference endpoints during Dedicated POC.
Elaine (Finance): Net30 invoice is standard for this account, but they asked for split invoicing for POC vs production. Need to confirm billing entity and VAT handling.
Jordan (Eng): For the POC they'll want Dedicated capacity (1x A10G equivalent) + VPC peering and HSM KMS for keying. If the POC is covered by Hosted terms we can't promise HSM in same way. Need clarity: is the POC under Dedicated reserved capacity or Hosted trial?
Sam (Sales): Good Q. Customer said "private POC" in the doc; leaning Dedicated. I'll flag that. If Dedicated, SLA should be part of the reserved capacity contract, right?
Alex (Legal): Correct — SLA commitments are part of Dedicated contract. If they want 99.95% we need to check with SRE on feasibility and whether credits formula needs adjustment. Also, for signing: we can do sequential countersign (prod exec last) or three-way parallel via DocuSign. Which does procurement prefer?
Elaine (Finance): Parallel is faster for them. We need PO number on the invoice and wire instructions. If they want Net45 we need approval from FP&A — not automatic.
Maria (Ops): If Exec isn't immediately available, we can do an approval-by-email fallback but must record audit trail + countersign step once exec is back. That avoids blocking the POC start.
Security Bot: (automated) Request: attach SOC2 Type II report, current pen-test summary, and confirm encryption-in-transit + at-rest. Also need to confirm whether any PHI will be involved — that triggers HIPAA addendum.
Jordan (Eng): No PHI expected for this POC. Confirming VPC + HSM requirement means we need a Private deployment ticket. That can add 2-3 business days setup time.
Sam (Sales): Ok — plan: I will push updated order form with mapping, attach redlined DPA from customer, and request parallel signing. Can Legal draft a short addendum for the SLA credits and HSM scope?
Alex (Legal): I can draft a 1-page SLA addendum that scopes the 99.95% target to inference endpoints on the Dedicated pool and includes credits formula. I'll also add the AES-256 at-rest clause and a subprocessor disclosure timeline.
Elaine (Finance): If Legal adds split-invoicing clause we're fine with Net30. Please include invoice routing: finance@customer.com and billing@redwood.com.
Sam (Sales): Routing mapping I'll include in the order form. Quick sample I'll paste here: 
```
Signers mapping:
- procurement@customer.com => Procurement signer (first)
- finance@customer.com => Finance (parallel)
- ceo@customer.com => Exec (parallel)
Fallback: if exec not available, ext-approval-email + audit log then final countersign within 7 days.
PO: 2026-4452-PO
```
Alex (Legal): That mapping looks fine. Make sure Docusign envelope has the redline PDF attached and that we request signer evidence (role verification).
Deploy Bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_id: env_0a9c2f). Status: in process.
Sam (Sales): @Alex (Legal) can you confirm you'll accept the customer redline except for two clauses (SLA credits & subprocessor timing)? I'll mark those as "open" and include them in the addendum.
Alex (Legal): Yes, accept except those two. I'll mark them open and prepare the addendum.
Maria (Ops): Ops note: if HSM key import is required, coordinate with infra@redwood and schedule maintenance window. Also capture network CIDR for peering.
Jordan (Eng): I'll need customer CIDR, expected qps and max sequence length for inference to size the Dedicated instance. Post metrics here and tag infra.
Elaine (Finance): Once addendum is ready, route to billing for signature. I can pre-approve Net30 pending the split invoice clause.
Sam (Sales): Great — I'll upload the redlined DPA and the order form now and tag legal + finance. Please react with :thumbsup: when you review.
Alex (Legal): Reviewing now.
Elaine (Finance): On it.
Jordan (Eng): Will send sizing details in a follow-up thread (keeping this one for legal/finance).
Sam (Sales): Thanks team — will update when envelope completes. :rocket:
